a: I bought this rain jacket for my daily walk to work, and it kept me mostly dry. The outer fabric was really good in a lot of ways, and the hood had a stiff brim that kept drops off my face. The zipper was smooth, and the pockets were deep enough for my phone and keys. However, the jacket did not breathe very well so I ended up sweaty after a brisk walk and the sleeves also ran a little long and the cuffs lacked adjustable tabs which was annoying when the sleeves ran long. After heavy downpours, the seams near the shoulders let in a small amount of water. It was a great jacket for any weather, but I did not rely on it for storms.
b: This chai concentrate is easy to use, since I just mix it with equal parts milk and heat it up. The spice blend is warm and fragrant, with plenty of cinnamon and ginger, and it makes a cozy drink in a few minutes. The problem is the sweetness. It is far too sugary for my taste, and the sugar hides the black tea almost completely. Cutting it with extra milk helps, but then the spices get weak. The carton also needs to be used within about a week after opening, and I rarely finish it in time. It is a handy shortcut, but I prefer making chai from scratch.
